_header.title: Independent list 1
_header.who: Written by an AI agent (Claude) in a fresh session told not to open any project file, asked for messages labelled by urgency as an emergency nurse would on a phone triage line, with typos, glued words, slang, non-native English, voice dictation, emergencies buried in small talk, misconceptions and counterexamples. 355 lines web-inspired, 335 invented.
_header.blind: Not blind any more: the urgency words (everyday wordings, idioms), the typo corrector and the English-word guard were built against it.
_header.fields: text (as typed), meaning (restated), triage (red/yellow/green), signs, kind, source; lists 3 and 4 add persona; list 4 adds lang and list
_header.note: Invented messages; no real person. This first line is the header; every other line is one message.
